$comment: Inputs for the R2 gate steps (pipeline:basin-gate, pipeline:lines-gate). Paths are relative to data/raw/; a .zip holding one shapefile is read through GDAL /vsizip/. srs is the layer's CRS as GDAL should read it (EPSG:22174, POSGAR 98 / Argentina 4, as the APRHI .prj files declare; read with always_xy, checked 2026-10-11). The province polygon is the scope for inside/outside areas and for the line comparison. searchBbox bounds the HydroBASINS/HydroRIVERS reads; it must contain every reference basin (the step checks it). assignMinShare: a HydroBASINS level-12 polygon joins the reference basin holding at least this share of its area. bufferM: the line-comparison distance, the same 250 m as the nqn IGN gate.
